decisions.reason: The camera has a page of its own on the website, so the firm has committed to it publicly, and its large investment in space qualification is central to the space direction it announced, which makes withdrawal within a year of launch unlikely.

This modular navigation camera is also presented on its own page and extends the firm's space sensor line, so its sunk development costs and visible commitment favour keeping it while early results can still be put down to long space procurement cycles.

Space situational awareness is a growing, strategically announced market where the firm has invested and committed publicly, and slow initial uptake can be explained by temporary causes such as long institutional procurement times.

The LiDAR is only mentioned on the website, so the public commitment is weaker, but the investment in space qualification and its fit with the firm's space portfolio still argue for persisting rather than dropping it this early.
